summary: Read every nonzero, non-blue value on the main diagonal in top-to-bottom order. Find the bounding box of all blue cells, preserve the input, and fill the blue frame's interior with those marker colors as nested rectangles from outside to inside. Each successive marker overwrites the next shrunken interior rectangle.
